title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17983v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Brain tumour segmentation from MR images is an integral part of their treatment, either through surgical resection or radiotherapy. Both applications require a high degree of precision that can be difficult to ensure for all patients due to the high degree of variability in the size, shape, number, and location of these tumours. This leads to difficulties with their automatic segmentation via deep learning, which can display catastrophic segmentation errors when presented with images that differ, even subtly, in terms of the specific MR sequence used, which varies from vendor to vendor. This article presents a deep-learning-based interactive segmentation system that, while being fully automatic by default, has the capability of being easily corrected by human users, allowing them ensure sufficiently high brain tumour segmentation accuracy for all patients. translated_title: 基于深度学习的交互式脑肿瘤分割界面
translated_abstract: 从磁共振（MR）图像中进行脑肿瘤分割是肿瘤治疗（无论是手术切除还是放疗）不可或缺的组成部分。这两种应用都需要高度的精确性，但由于这些肿瘤在大小、形状、数量和位置上存在高度的可变性，很难确保对所有患者都能达到这种精确性。这给通过深度学习进行自动分割带来了困难——当图像在所使用的特定MR序列方面存在差异（即使差异很细微，且不同厂商的序列各不相同）时，深度学习模型可能出现灾难性的分割错误。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的交互式分割系统，该系统默认情况下完全自动运行，同时具备易于人工校正的能力，使用户能够确保所有患者的脑肿瘤分割精度足够高。该界面从其自动方法的准确性和……
tldr: 本文提出了一种默认全自动运行但允许人工轻松校正的深度学习交互式脑肿瘤分割系统，从而能够为所有患者确保足够高的分割精度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an interactive deep-learning-based brain tumour segmentation system that is fully automatic by default yet can be easily corrected by human users, ensuring sufficiently high segmentation accuracy for all patients.
